stage: Design review only. Await user confirmation before individual high-resolution generation or cutting. No site integration.
male:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: character casting/contact sheet for approval of an original avatar collection. The supplied image is ONLY a STYLE QUALITY reference: premium expressive 3D animated-film character portraits, groomed detailed hair, appealing sculpted faces, soft skin shading, richly colored tactile clothing, convincing cloth and leather, beautiful studio key and fill lighting. Create NEW characters; do not reproduce the reference's same man or its composition. NOT a photo, not a low-poly or primitive mesh render, not bobbleheads, no huge round faces. All characters are attractive adults in their 20s-30s, primarily East Asian appearance, clearly varied facial identities, tapered jaws and individual eye/brow/nose shapes. Cohesive rendering style but distinct fashion, facial expressions, hairstyles, hand gestures and personalities.
Deliver a very high-resolution SQUARE 4 by 4 grid showing EXACTLY SIXTEEN distinct chest-up avatar cutouts. Read row-major left to right. Generous regular transparent gutters and margins; no overlapping characters between cells, no hair or hands cut off, torso terminates cleanly at bottom of each cell. Consistent face sizes and camera distance. Real transparent alpha background, NO paper, NO torn edges, NO backdrops, NO circles, NO cards, NO floor, NO shadow behind the cutout, NO scenery. Each avatar is fully isolated including any hand or held object. Heads turned varied slightly towards camera, readable expressive eyes. Anatomically correct hands. No brand names or logos, no signatures, no watermark. Only small clear item IDs underneath each figure for review, no title or extra copy. This is an approval sheet; later the selected designs will be individually regenerated in high resolution. Prioritize refined character art and strong distinction between identities.
Sheet: 16 MALE characters, small IDs M01 to M16 beneath figures. Arrange:
Row 1:
M01: wavy dark brown short quiff, slim oval face, sapphire blue knitted crewneck over white collar, thin dark glasses, one hand adjusting glasses, confident playful wink.

M04: chestnut loose short curls, warm freckled face, black-and-ivory striped knit, holding open navy book in both hands, genuinely laughing with crinkled eyes.
Row 2:
M05: dark cropped textured hair, athletic square jaw, burnt orange overshirt over cream tee, one thumb up, energetic grin.
M06: soft black curtain hair, delicate narrow face, teal casual jacket, holding clear unbranded iced coffee cup with straw, curious lifted brow.
M07: dark softly wavy hair, charming broad brows, purple knit vest over white shirt, open palm friendly wave, warm toothy smile.
M08: medium chestnut center-part waves, elegant face, dusty rose linen shirt, hands gently together in a relaxed greeting, serene closed-mouth smile.
Row 3:
M09: icy silver short side-swept hair, sharp face, charcoal techwear zip jacket, one hand on over-ear headphones at neck, cool half-smile.
M10: warm brown windswept cropped hair, athletic face, navy-and-cream varsity jacket, holding small orange basketball tucked near chest, cheerful determined eyes.
M11: black tousled soft waves, narrow jaw, sage green chore jacket, holding compact silver camera at chest with both hands, quiet friendly smile.
